title: Drives Registry File (drives.json)
description: Schema for the drives registry. Drives are the weighted goals and aversions that NPCs hold; storylet preconditions and temporal-layer aggregation read drives to determine narrative salience. Per ADR-0012. The drives.json file at project root maps drive ids to drive definitions.

valence.description: A positive_goal drive motivates NPCs to take action toward something (e.g., protect_village, accumulate_wealth). A negative_aversion drive motivates NPCs to avoid something (e.g., avoid_outsiders, fear_deep_places).

category.description: Drive category. Used for storylet salience aggregation and for filtering drives in template assignment.

scope.description: universal: any NPC can hold this. culture_scoped: only NPCs of specific cultures. sub_faction_scoped: tied to a sub_faction. role_scoped: tied to specific roles.

scope_restrictions.description: When scope is not universal, the specific URNs this drive is restricted to. Validator enforces.

typical_weight_range.description: Suggested weight range for templates that assign this drive. Not enforced; informational.

satisfies.description: Optional. Higher-order drives this one satisfies. Used by storylet salience to recognize when an action serves multiple drives.

conflicts_with.description: Optional. Drives that conflict with this one. An NPC holding both at high weight experiences internal tension, surfaced through storylets.
